latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 10th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: No decision made on LMT/Tet ownership issues
latvia.description: In-depth negotiations are currently under way with no fewer than 23 investors regarding potential involvement in the purchase of shares of LMT and Tet from the Swedish telecommunications company Telia. This was stated by Economics Minister Viktors Valainis (Greens and Farmers' Union, ZZS) after an extraordinary government meeting convened specifically for this issue on July 10th.

latvia.title: Latvia's foreign trade figures were on the up in May
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau provisional data show that in May 2026 Latvia had foreign trade turnover of 3.86 billion euro, and at current prices it was 8.4 % higher than a year ago.

latvia.title: Lithuanian arrested in big cigarette seizure in Rīga
latvia.description: Tax and Customs Police officers, in cooperation with State Border Guard officers, conducted an inspection of a warehouse in Rīga, in the Teika suburb, at the end of June this year. During the search, a large quantity of cigarettes, vehicles, tracking devices and other items were seized, indicating an intention to covertly transport a large quantity of cigarettes of illegal origin.

latvia.title: 'Lion's Leap' military exercises taking place this weekend
latvia.description: From July 11 to 12, the international military exercise “Lions Leap” will be held in the vicinity of Ozolaine, Vecsaule parish, Bauska district, in which the 53rd Infantry Battalion of the 1st Riga Brigade of the National Guard, the 503rd Infantry Company of the Lithuanian National Guard, and soldiers of the 2025 draft of the State Defense Service will participate.

latvia.title: Latvia celebrates 50th heart transplant
latvia.description: The 50th heart transplant in Latvia has taken place at Pauls Stradiņš Clinical University Hospital (PSKUS), reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Young jazz musicians to shine through summer concert competition
latvia.description: The jazz club "M/Darbnīca – M/House of Jazz" is holding a new generation jazz competition "Young and Talented" on Wednesdays in July and August, which takes place in the format of a concert cycle, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Rīga introduces management fees for municipal apartments
latvia.description: From this month, Rīga will start collecting management fees for municipality-owned apartments.

latvia.title: Wind turbine loses blade during test run in Latvia
latvia.description: A loud noise, reminiscent of thunder, shook the Karosta neighbourhood in Liepāja on Wednesday evening. Although strong winds were battering the city in Kurzeme, the cause this time was different: during equipment testing at the Rapsoil wind farm, the blade of one turbine snapped and fell. The rotor is located on the outskirts of the city; no one was injured, TV Kurzeme reports.

latvia.title: Ostapenko wins first Wimbledon mixed doubles title
latvia.description: Latvian tennis star Aļona Ostapenko, paired with Salvadoran Marcelo Arevalo, won the mixed doubles final at the Wimbledon Championships on Thursday. It is the former French Open champion's first grand slam title on grass.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Festivals abound
latvia.description: Which festival will you choose for this weekend?

latvia.title: Dry and hot weather to begin in Latvia Sunday
latvia.description: Starting Sunday, the weather in Latvia will become drier and warmer, and will often be even hot, according to forecasts by weatherman Toms Bricis.

latvia.title: Latvia is Belarus' first target for hybrid war: Border Guard chief
latvia.description: Latvia is currently the number one target of Belarus’s hybrid warfare, and the challenges are immense, Guntis Pujāts, commander of the State Border Guard, told Latvian Television on July 9 regarding the situation on the eastern border.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 9th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: University enrolment begins in Latvia Thursday
latvia.description: On Thursday, July 9, the unified admissions process for undergraduate programs began at eight Latvian universities. Online applications for admission will continue on the “Latvija.lv” portal from Thursday through July 20, while prospective students will be able to apply in person starting July 14, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Staged robbery uncovered in Ogre, Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police have uncovered a staged robbery in Ogre that was organised to conceal the embezzlement of company funds, police said on July 9.

latvia.title: Organic dairy brand Bryunaļa discontinued in Latvia
latvia.description: The agricultural services cooperative “Viļāni” has a wide range of organic dairy products and the “Bryunaļa” brand, which was launched 11 years ago. Due to the unprofitability of the production facility, a decision was made to discontinue the production of organic dairy products as of July 10, Latvian Radio reported on July 9.

latvia.title: Man drives luxury cars, steals fuel and sandwiches
latvia.description: Police officers in Pārdaugava arrested a young man who, since this spring, had stolen fuel from at least six gas stations in Rīga and the surrounding area using luxury cars. The suspect is currently being held in temporary custody, according to the State Police.

latvia.title: Election candidate removed due to lack of Latvian citizenship
latvia.description: The Central Election Commission (CVK) decided on Thursday to remove Jurijs Jesipenko from the list of candidates for the 15th Saeima election in the Rīga electoral district submitted by the political party alliance “Harmony Centre,” the CVK told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: PM Kulbergs rates his cabinet '7 out of 10' after first month in office
latvia.description: The government of Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) has fully completed three of a total of 61 priority tasks within a month, he announced at a press conference after a meeting to discuss the government's actions so far.

latvia.title: 'Key figures on Europe' 2026 edition now available
latvia.description: On July 9th Eurostat has released the 2026 edition of its Key figures on Europe.

latvia.title: Latvia's macroeconomic forecasts revised by Finance Ministry
latvia.description: The Ministry of Finance (FM) has updated its indicative medium-term macroeconomic and fiscal forecasts, taking into account the latest economic trends and the geopolitical situation. The forecasts indicate slower economic growth and higher inflation than projected in February of this year, the FM reported.

latvia.title: Lots of lilies coming to Latvian Nature Museum
latvia.description: From July 16 to 18, the Latvian National Museum of Natural History will host “Lilies 2026,” a particularly colourful and fragrant exhibition for the gardening season, the museum announced.

latvia.title: Two minors get prison sentence for double homicide
latvia.description: Two minors have been sentenced to 12 years and six months in prison and three years of probation for the murder of two people in Rēzekne, the Latgale District Court has ruled, according to the Prosecutor's Office.

latvia.title: Central Rīga street sections to be closed until end of July
latvia.description: To complete the installation of bike lanes and improvements to street intersections on the section of Dzirnavu Street between Tērbatas Street and Skolas Street, starting Thursday, July 9, through July 30, traffic restrictions will be in place on Dzirnavu Street, according to the Riga City Council.

latvia.title: Railway platform modernization project has big problems
latvia.description: The project to make Latvia's crumbling railway platforms resemble something from the 21st century is experiencing severe delays, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Baltic air policing mission switches to air defence mission
latvia.description: NATO will reassign its longstanding Baltic air policing mission as an air defence mission, according to an agreement reached at a summit of NATO member states' leaders in the Turkish capital, Ankara, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: AI data centre to help Latvian doctors make quicker diagnoses
latvia.description: Time is of the essence in diagnosing diseases, including cancer, as well as in selecting the most appropriate treatment methods. Thanks to high-performance computing, what used to take years can now be analysed much more quickly. A new artificial intelligence data server will provide Latvian scientists with this opportunity, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: Latvian Border Guard chief: Migrant smugglers are getting aggressive
latvia.description: Migrant smugglers have become more aggressive, and border guards are having to use increasingly aggressive methods to apprehend them, said Guntis Pujāts, commander of the State Border Guard (VRS), in an interview on the Latvian Radio programme “Good Morning” on July 9.

latvia.title: Latvian SUBmerge to work with industry giant Naval Group
latvia.description: On Wednesday, July 8, the Latvian underwater drone manufacturer "SUBmerge Baltic" signed a memorandum of cooperation with the French defence and maritime technology company "Naval Group," Latvian Radio reported on July 8.

latvia.title: Drones help check power lines in Latvia
latvia.description: Work that used to take several hours in some places can now be completed in a matter of minutes. The electricity distribution network "Sadales tīkls" is increasingly using drones to inspect power lines, Latvian Television reported on July 8.

latvia.title: airBaltic fleet down two planes
latvia.description: Latvia's national airline, "airBaltic," has reached a mutual agreement with one of its aircraft lessors regarding the early return of two "Airbus A220-300" aircraft at the end of June this year, Augusts Zilberts, airBaltic’s head of public and political relations, confirmed to the LETA news agency.

lithuania.title: Figyelmeztet a hírszerzés: egész egyszerű trükkel figyelte meg Oroszország a NATO-szállítmányokat
lithuania.description: Orosz hackerek internetre csatlakoztatott kamerákon keresztül végeznek kémtevékenységet – derült ki a holland Általános Hírszerző és Biztonsági Szolgálat, valamint a Katonai Hírszerző és Biztonsági Szolgálat közös közleményéből. A nagyszabású művelet fő célpontjai a NATO európai tagállamai, köztük Hollandia, valamint Ukrajna - írta meg a Militarnyi .

lithuania.title: Jarosław Kaczyński o akcesji Ukrainy do UE: zrobimy wszystko, by nie weszła
lithuania.description: Ukraina nie może wejść do Unii Europejskiej z bagażem banderyzmu. Zrobimy wszystko, by nie weszła, jeśli się z tego nie wycofa - oświadczył prezes PiS Jarosław Kaczyński. Zapowiedź ta padła w czasie obchodów rocznicy rzezi wołyńskiej w Chełmie.

lithuania.title: Zmarł republikański senator Lindsey Graham
lithuania.description: Zmarł republikański senator Lindsey Graham - poinformowało biuro polityka. Polityk zmarł z powodu "krótkiej i nagłej choroby". Miał 71 lat.

lithuania.title: Rocznica zbrodni wołyńskiej. "Traktowali Polaków jako śmiertelnych wrogów"
lithuania.description: Najlepsze, co mogłoby się wydarzyć, jeśli Ukraina i Polska chcą deeskalacji, to wstrzymać oddech i zacząć rozmowy na temat tego, jak wyjść z tego spiętrzenia problemów - powiedział profesor Grzegorz Motyka. W "Faktach po Faktach" w TVN24 mówił o zbrodni wołyńskiej i napięciu w polsko-ukraińskich relacjach.

lithuania.title: Wołodymyr Zełenski o ofiarach zbrodni wołyńskiej: potrzebna jest pełna prawda
lithuania.description: Mówiąc o tym, co było, nie możemy podważać przyszłości naszych narodów – przyszłości Ukrainy, Polski, przyszłości całej naszej Europy - przekazał prezydent Ukrainy Wołodymyr Zełenski w 83. rocznicę rzezi wołyńskiej. Zapewnił, że Ukraina jest zainteresowana przyspieszeniem prac poszukiwawczych na Wołyniu.

lithuania.title: 25 lat TVN24 i 15 lat "Czarno na białym". Wyjątkowe spotkanie z widzami
lithuania.description: TVN24 obchodzi swoje 25 urodziny. 15 lat kończy natomiast redakcja "Czarno na białym" i również z jej dziennikarzami widzowie mogli spotkać się w Bydgoszczy, w ramach urodzinowej trasy "Jesteśmy stąd". Na spotkaniu w sali kinowej były wyświetlane reportaże, a następnie był czas na uwagi, dyskusję i poznanie się na żywo.

lithuania.title: Republikánsky senátor Lindsey Graham náhle zomrel vo veku 71 rokov
lithuania.description: Senátor zomrel po náhlej chorobe. Jeden z najvernejších podporovateľov Donalda Trumpa tesne pred smrťou navštívil aj Kyjev.

lithuania.title: Náhle zemřel americký senátor Lindsey Graham
lithuania.description: Ve věku 71 let v sobotu večer náhle zemřel dlouholetý republikánský senátor za Jižní Karolínu Lindsey Graham. Oznámila to jeho kancelář v prohlášení vydaném v neděli brzy ráno. Graham byl vlivným členem Kongresu a podporovatelem Ukrajiny. Zemřel krátce po návštěvě Kyjeva.

lithuania.title: 4 věci, ze kterých mají muži na začátku vztahu největší strach
lithuania.description: Podobně jako ženy i muži mají nejrůznější obavy. Na rozdíl od žen si je ale zejména ve vztazích nechávají pro sebe. Nechtějí si je ani přiznat, natož aby o nich mluvili. Pro mnohé by to bylo stejně jako pláč projevem slabosti či neschopnosti. Ale teprve až si je přiznají, mohou je porazit a položit tak pevné základy nového vztahu.

lithuania.title: KOMENTÁŘ: Trump u pasti dlouhé války - Alex Švamberk
lithuania.description: Situace v Perském zálivu se tento týden vyhrotila do té míry, že americký prezident Donald Trump na summitu NATO označil Memorandum o porozumění mezi USA a Íránem za mrtvé. Írán útočil na tankery v Hormuzské úžině a po amerických náletech vypálil balistické rakety na Kuvajt, Bahrajn a dokonce i Katar, který zprostředkovává mírová jednání.

lithuania.title: Zemřel vlivný republikánský senátor Lindsey Graham
lithuania.description: Zemřel americký senátor Lindsey Graham, uvedla agentura Reuters s odkazem na jeho kancelář. Jednasedmdesátiletý republikán patřil k nejvlivnějším členům Kongresu, a to hlavně v zahraniční politice. V posledních letech podporoval Ukrajinu a její boj proti ruské agresi. Americký prezident Donald Trump označil Grahama za jednoho z nejlepších zákonodárců a skutečného amerického vlastence. Bude hodně chybět, dodal. Grahama ocenil rovněž izraelský premiér Benjamin Netanjahu.

lithuania.title: Čína a Rusko v době summitu NATO upořádaly vojenské cvičení v Tichomoří
lithuania.description: Důležitým tématem summitu NATO v Ankaře byl kromě obranných výdajů a Ukrajiny i Indopacifik. Aliance hledá novou formu spolupráce se spojenci v Tichomoří, kteří se jednání také zúčastnili. Cílem je čelit rostoucí hrozbě Číny a Ruska, které v době summitu navíc uspořádaly společné vojenské manévry. Cvičení končí v neděli.

lithuania.title: Ve Varech vyhrálo Padlé ovoce, natočil jej myanmarský režisér v české koprodukci
lithuania.description: Křišťálový glóbus v Karlových Varech získal koprodukční snímek s účastí České republiky Padlé ovoce, za kterým stojí debutující režisér z Myanmaru Aun Pčou. Na dramatu o posedlosti a queer touze se podíleli také filmaři z Myanmaru a Francie. Kromě cen v soutěži se předávala také čestná ocenění za přínos kinematografii, a to slovenské herečce a diplomatce Magdě Vášáryové, americkému herci Jeffreymu Wrightovi a francouzské herečce Juliette Binocheové.

lithuania.title: Pavel věří, že se jeho vztahy s Babišem uklidní
lithuania.description: Prezident Petr Pavel věří, že po sporech ohledně účasti na posledním summitu NATO se jeho vztahy s premiérem Andrejem Babišem (ANO) uklidní. Pavel to v sobotu řekl v diskusi na multižánrovém festivalu Pohoda na Slovensku, kde se sešel s tamní exprezidentkou Zuzanou Čaputovou. Pavel označil za absurdní snahu vládního hnutí Svoboda a přímá demokracie (SPD), aby ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj přišel o nejvyšší české státní vyznamenání, Řád bílého lva.

lithuania.title: Ministerul Apărării: Dronele au schimbat războiul. NATO investește peste 40 de miliarde de dolari în programul Drone Edge
lithuania.description: NATO a creat programul Drone Edge, o inițiativă a organizației prin care se urmărește dezvoltarea și achiziția de capabilități moderne pentru detectarea și combatarea dronelor. Ministerul Apărării din România explică că programul a fost necesar din cauza faptului că dronele au schimbat modul în care se poartă războiul.

lithuania.title: Senatorul american Lindsay Graham, aliatul lui Trump și susținător al Ucrainei, a murit „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”
lithuania.description: Lindsey Graham, republican din Carolina de Sud, care a fost ales în Senat în 2003 și a fost un aliat politic apropiat de-ai președintelui Donald Trump, a decedat, a confirmat biroul său duminică dimineața. Avea 71 de ani. Graham a decedat sâmbătă seara „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”, a precizat biroul său într-un comunicat citat de NBC News.

lithuania.title: Nu există expunere „sigură” la soare fără protecție, arată un nou studiu. Care sunt riscurile
lithuania.description: Chiar şi perioadele scurte de expunere la soare, la intervale orare considerate în mod tradiţional „sigure”, pot să provoace leziuni cutanate şi să contribuie la creşterea riscului de cancer de piele, conform concluziilor unui studiu australian.

lithuania.title: Momentul de cotitură pentru Europa. Cât de realist e termenul 2030 pentru un conflict NATO-Rusia: ofițerii militari au păreri diferite
lithuania.description: Oamenii lui Putin apar brusc în Narva, un mic oraș de graniță de la marginea flancului estic al NATO din Estonia. Ei seamănă semințele discordiei și susțin că populația majoritară vorbitoare de limbă rusă este discriminată. Este începutul unui scenariu de conflict Rusia-NATO. Ofițerii militari din Europa cred că cel mai periculos moment pentru continent va veni în anii de după un acord de pace în Ucraina. Ar putea Rusia să atace Estonia?

lithuania.title: Rusia a piratat camere video civile de pe rutele logistice din țările NATO, pentru a monitoriza transporturile militare către Ucraina
lithuania.description: Hackerii ruși au piratat camere de supraveghere conectate la internet, inclusiv un număr redus amplasate de-a lungul rutelor militare din Țările de Jos, au informat agențiile de informații olandeze. Aceste breșe de securitate i-au permis Rusiei să culeagă informații privind rutele de transport militar și echipamentele de apărare livrate Ucrainei, relatează nltimes.nl.

lithuania.title: Patru senatori americani „au ajuns la un acord cu Trump” pentru extinderea sancțiunilor împotriva „mașinii de război a lui Putin”
lithuania.description: Patru senatori americani au declarat vineri că au ajuns la un acord cu administrația Trump pentru a avansa cu legislația actualizată privind sancțiunile împotriva Rusiei, relatează TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Daniel Zamfir (PSD) spune că numirea de către Oana Gheorghiu a unui consilier este dovada că Ilie Bolojan nu vrea să plece din Guvern
lithuania.description: Senatorul PSD Daniel Zamfir o acuză pe Oana Gheorghiu, vicepremier în guvernul demis condus de Ilie Bolojan, de „sfidare și dispreț bolojenist”, după ce vicepremierul a numit un consilier de stat la cabinetul său. Zamfir consideră că numirea este o dovadă a faptului că Ilie Bolojan nu vrea să plece de la Palatul Victoria.

lithuania.title: Ce este și cum funcționează GlobalEye, viitoarea platformă NATO de avertizare timpurie și supraveghere aeriană. Explicațiile MApN
lithuania.description: Ministerul Apărării a transmis, vineri, detalii despre GlobalEye, noul Sistem Aerian de Avertizare şi Control al NATO, precizând că poate detecta simultan drone, avioane, nave şi rachete aflate la sute de kilometri distanţă. Radarul nu se roteşte, zboară la 13.000 de metri altitudine şi are o autonomie de 12 ore.

lithuania.title: „Rețeaua morții”. NATO va folosi inteligența artificială pe Flancul Estic, inclusiv în România, pentru contracararea amenințărilor ruse
lithuania.description: NATO va apăra Flancul Estic cu inteligență artificială. Alianța va dezvolta o rețea care va aduna, într-un singur loc, informațiile obținute de sateliți, drone, și alte sisteme, din mai multe state membre, inclusiv din România. Întregul sistem va fi construit pentru ca amenințările să fie identificate mult mai rapid decât în prezent.

lithuania.title: „Marea Neagră nu mai este un lac rusesc”. Ce rol joacă alianța dintre Turcia și România, țara cu care Ankara are „zero probleme”
lithuania.description: Ankara nu a fost aleasă întâmplător pentru această ediție a Summitului NATO. Puține capitale aliate se află la intersecția atâtor teatre strategice: Marea Neagră, Orientul Mijlociu, Marea Mediterană și Caucazul. Este al cincilea an al războiului Rusiei în Ucraina, iar SUA vrea să se implice mai puțin în securitatea Europei. Ce rol capătă Turcia în aceste condiții? A explicat profesorul Hüseyin Bağcı, în emisiunea "Pașaport diplomatic".

lithuania.title: China i-a dat un ultimatum lui Putin privind folosirea armelor nucleare în Ucraina, dezvăluie Zelenski
lithuania.description: China a avertizat Rusia să nu folosească arme nucleare ca răspuns la atacurile ucrainene asupra teritoriului său, a declarat joi președintele Ucrainei, Volodimir Zelenski, potrivit Politico. El a precizat că a aflat despre intervenția Beijingului de la liderii europeni, în cadrul summitului NATO de la Ankara.

lithuania.title: PNL ar putea organiza un nou Congres în august sau septembrie. Fenechiu: „Putem face și mai repede”
lithuania.description: Actuala conducere PNL ia în calcul să organizeze un nou Congres în perioada următoare, în august sau septembrie, a declarat liderul senatorilor liberali, Daniel Fenechiu. Planul vine în contextul în care instanța a dat dreptate liberalilor din tabăra anti-Bolojan și a suspendat deciziile Congresului din iunie, unde a fost modificat statutul și au fost aleși noi lideri în conducerea partidului.

lithuania.title: Rusia a început să producă mașini BMW contrafăcute cu piese abandonate de compania germană în 2022
lithuania.description: Grupul auto german BMW a acuzat Rusia că produce în fabrica „Avtotor” din Kaliningrad mașini cu sigla BMW fără să existe o autorizare din parte companiei germane. Fabrica folosește acum componente fabricate local și vinde mașinile la prețuri premium. Rusia continuă să sfideze legile internaționale comerciale prin producția de vehicule contrafăcute. lithuania.title: Scandal diplomatic la Cupa Mondială 2026. Derapaj din Argentina, sancționat de Franța
lithuania.description: Ambasada Franței în Argentina a declarat-o „persona non grata” pe o viceguvernatoare regională în relația cu instituția și în cadrul cooperării bilaterale, după ce aceasta a publicat pe X un mesaj în care descria selecționata de fotbal a Franței drept o „echipă africană, fără maniere”, potrivit informațiilor confirmate duminică de misiunea diplomatică, scrie duminică AFP. …

lithuania.title: VIDEO Dronele ucrainene au lovit rafinăria de petrol Sizran și un petrolier în Marea Azov / O persoană a fost ucisă în atacul cu drone din regiunea Samara
lithuania.description: Drone militare ucrainene au atacat, duminică naptea, o rafinărie de petrol din Sizran, regiunea Samara, Rusia. Un incendiu a izbucnit în incinta rafinăriei. Guvernatorul regiunii Samara, Viaceslav Fedorișcev, a declarat că atacurile cu drone au avariat clădiri rezidențiale și o instalație industrială, fără a specifica care dintre acestea. lithuania.title: Lindsey Graham, senator republican și aliat al lui Trump, a murit la 71 de ani / El s-a întors vineri dintr-o vizită în Ucraina
lithuania.description: Lindsey Graham, senatorul american și aliat de seamă al lui Donald Trump, a decedat, relatează The Washington Post, The Guardian și Sky News. Politicianul în vârstă de 71 de ani, care a fost reprezentant republican al statului Carolina de Sud, a murit sâmbătă „în urma unei boli scurte și subite”, a anunțat biroul său. „Familia […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: Russian disinformation surge may be connected to upcoming Baltic elections
lithuania.description: An uptick in Russian disinformation aimed at NATO's eastern flank could be linked to Latvia and Estonia's upcoming parliamentary elections, experts say.

lithuania.title: Estonia joins other 2 Baltic states in protest over Russian airspace claims
lithuania.description: The foreign ministries of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania have issued a statement strongly rejecting disinformation efforts by Russia's Foreign Ministry over alleged use of their airspace in drone strikes on Russia.

lithuania.title: Peeter Kaldre: The time of Europe began in Ankara
lithuania.description: The NATO summit in Ankara may go down in history for the decision that Europe will ultimately take over the alliance's future leadership role from the United States, Peeter Kaldre writes.

lithuania.title: NATO Ankara summit gift leaves Estonian prime minister with revolver dilemma
lithuania.description: Prime Minister Kristen Michal (Reform) came from this week's NATO summit in Ankara bearing an unusual gift — a revolver which he has had to leave behind in Turkey, Delfi reported.

lithuania.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Ukraina on ühe nädalaga rünnanud 70 venelaste tankerit
lithuania.description: Ukraina armee jätkas rünnakuid tankeritele Aasovi merel. Alates teisipäevast on Ukraina armee teadete põhjal tabatud juba üle 70 tankeri ja mõne muu laeva, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks (Parempoolsed).

lithuania.title: Ukraina tuli lõpuks välja oma kaitsetehnoloogia ekspordiplaaniga – see on ka Euroopale paljulubav
lithuania.description: Neli aastat sõda on muutnud Ukraina üheks maailma kiiremini arenevaks kaitsetehnoloogia keskuseks. Nüüd soovib riik oma lahinguväljal tõestatud lahendusi pakkuda ka liitlastele, säilitades samal ajal kontrolli kodumaise varustatuse üle. Selleks on loodud uus ekspordisüsteem, mille eesmärk on tasakaalustada julgeoleku- ja majandushuvid. Kuidas see mudel töötab ning miks peetakse seda Ukraina jaoks nii oluliseks? Vastused avavad sõja kõrval vähem tähelepanu saanud muutuse.

lithuania.title: Suri USA senaator Lindsey Graham
lithuania.description: Äsja Ukraina-visiidilt naasnud USA vabariiklasest senaator Lindsey Graham suri laupäeval 71 aasta vanuselt pärast äkilist haigestumist, vahendab USA meedia.

lithuania.title: USA isejuhtivad robotsõidukid jõudsid Ukraina lahinguväljadele
lithuania.description: Ukraina lahinguväljadest on saanud koht, kus järgmise põlvkonna autonoomsed sõidukid läbivad oma kõige karmima eksami. Seal ei määra edu laborikatsetes saavutatud tulemused, vaid suutlikkus toime tulla ettearvamatu sõjareaalsusega. Esimesed kogemused annavad põhjust nii optimismiks kui ka ettevaatlikkuseks. Kui kaugel on päev, mil sellised masinad suudavad tegutseda ilma pideva inimese sekkumiseta? Vastus võib kujundada autonoomsete sõjasüsteemide järgmise arenguetapi.

lithuania.title: Ukraina ajaloolane 1600. sõjapäeva puhul: sõda muutub veel verisemaks, tsiviilohvrite arv suureneb
lithuania.description: Nii Venemaa kui ka Ukraina sagenenud õhurünnakud näitavad, et ees ootab sõja eskaleerumine kahjuks veelgi suuremate tsiviilohvrite arvuga mõlemal pool, ütles sõja 1600. päevale pühendatud intervjuus üks Ukraina tuntumaid ajaloolasi ja mõtlejaid, Lvivis asuva Ukraina katoliku ülikooli professor Jaroslav Hrõtsak. Ukraina täiemahulise sõja 1600. päev jõudis kätte täna.

lithuania.title: Lithuanian arrested in big cigarette seizure in Rīga
lithuania.description: Tax and Customs Police officers, in cooperation with State Border Guard officers, conducted an inspection of a warehouse in Rīga, in the Teika suburb, at the end of June this year. During the search, a large quantity of cigarettes, vehicles, tracking devices and other items were seized, indicating an intention to covertly transport a large quantity of cigarettes of illegal origin.

lithuania.title: 'Lion's Leap' military exercises taking place this weekend
lithuania.description: From July 11 to 12, the international military exercise “Lions Leap” will be held in the vicinity of Ozolaine, Vecsaule parish, Bauska district, in which the 53rd Infantry Battalion of the 1st Riga Brigade of the National Guard, the 503rd Infantry Company of the Lithuanian National Guard, and soldiers of the 2025 draft of the State Defense Service will participate.

lithuania.title: Baltic air policing mission switches to air defence mission
lithuania.description: NATO will reassign its longstanding Baltic air policing mission as an air defence mission, according to an agreement reached at a summit of NATO member states' leaders in the Turkish capital, Ankara, reports Latvian Television.
